versions.content: An invocation of a RP service function shall conform to the prototype: void <RptServiceSymbol>( uint16 <rptEventId>, uint16 <servicePointId> uint8 <stimEnabler> ); Where <RptServiceSymbol> is specified as the RptProfile . service- PointSymbolPre or RptProfile . servicePointSymbolPost and <servicePointid> is the RP service point id . The <stimEnabler> provides run-time control of RP stimuation.
